title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
objective: Study flame spread over solid fuels in low-speed flows and measure material flammability limits in microgravity.
researchImpacts: Results show that the standard normal-gravity flammability screening test is not conservative for microgravity.

publications.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II: Researcher Guide

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
objective: Measure how diluent gases and pressure affect extinction of burning fuel droplets in microgravity.
researchImpacts: Revealed a cool-flame regime that persists after visible flame-out and informs fire suppression design.

publications.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment: droplet burning results

title: Coflow and Inverse Flames (CIFM / gas jets)
objective: Characterize gas-jet diffusion flames, including soot and extinction behavior, in microgravity.
researchImpacts: Provides flame shape and extinction data used to validate combustion models.
dateNote: Run dates not tabulated in the dataset record.

title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment Reflight
objective: Measure smoke particle size and detector response for overheated spacecraft materials.
researchImpacts: Showed that ISS-style photoelectric smoke detectors can miss smoke from some overheated materials.

publications.title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment: detector response
